subject: RopeTech redlines: Order Form / MSA scope, training & feedback license
messages:
From: Emma Riley <emma.riley@ropetech.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@ropetech.com, matthew.kline@ropetech.com
Date: Mon, 27 Feb 2028 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: RopeTech - initial redlines on MSA + Order Form

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Team liked the latency numbers. Attached are our consolidated redlines for the MSA and the Order Form (high level asks: explicit product output title, training prohibition except for opt-in, and a telemetry/evidence request for evaluation). Matt from procurement is cc'd to confirm timing.

High-level asks: 
- Output ownership: RopeTech requests assignment of output title for productized features that embed our dataset (we can discuss scope).
- Training & feedback: explicit prohibition on using our data for continuous model training unless we opt in via a separate addendum.
- Evidence: we need a short runbook describing how Redwood will provide telemetry/evidence (logs/retention, sample outputs) for compliance purposes.

Attached: Ropetech_MSA_redline_v3.pdf, ROPETECH_OrderForm_v2_redline.docx

Can you confirm who on the Redwood legal side will triage? Also ok to propose a small mutual action plan (MAP) with deadlines — procurement is targeting sign by 3/15.

Best,
Emma

[Attachment: Ropetech_MSA_redline_v3.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: ROPETECH_OrderForm_v2_redline.docx (DOCX)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 27 Feb 2028 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RopeTech - initial redlines on MSA + Order Form

Emma — thanks for the clear summary and the redlines. I pulled in Laura (legal) and Ben (sales operations) to coordinate the MAP. Quick confirmations from us:

1) We understand the ask on "output title" and the opt-in-only training prohibition. These are common asks; we typically propose a narrow productization carveout path where customer-owned prompts/datasets for specific product features can be assigned.

2) For evidence/telemetry we can provide a compliance packet: request logs, sampling of model outputs, and a short retention matrix. We use a standard SOC2 summary and can generate a tailored evidence runbook.

Proposed next steps:
- Laura to review redlines and propose language that balances productization vs. platform service model (target EOD Wed 2/29).
- Ben to draft a MAP with milestones aimed at 3/15 signature (procurement checkpoint 3/8).
- Karthik to propose a limited training carveout (90-day evaluation telemetry window + opt-in for retraining) as a compromise.

Would you like a short call to walk the redlines tomorrow? Happy to host legal + procurement.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment stub: SOC2_summary.pdf]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Emma Riley <emma.riley@ropetech.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 Feb 2028 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RopeTech - initial redlines on MSA + Order Form

Emma / team — I reviewed the redlines PDF and the Order Form track-changes. Thanks for being explicit. A few notes from legal: 

- Output title: we can do a narrow assignment for "Productized Outputs" (defined by a rollup: specific product features that use only RopeTech data and are delivered as discrete artifacts). We will add a definition and two safeguards: a 12-month audit right and an integration checklist.

- Training prohibition: we accept opt-in only. To keep platform safety and continuous improvement intact for hosted customers, we propose limited telemetry collection for QA (sampled, anonymized) and a clause that telemetry will not be used for model training absent explicit written consent. That clause will include a retained-evidence process.

- Evidence/runbook: we will provide a "Compliance Evidence Appendix" describing artifacts (sample logs, retained outputs, retention period). Note this may require engineering to produce a one-time export for the audit window. Please confirm the required retention window (30/90/180 days).

Action items from legal: 
1) I'll circulate proposed language by EOD Wed 2/29 (redline suggestions inline).
2) Can RopeTech confirm whether productization assignment is company-wide or limited to specific SKUs?

If RopeTech wants to keep assignment broader than narrowly scoped product features, we'll need to surface additional commercial terms.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference
[signature]

From: Matthew Kline <matthew.kline@ropetech.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Emma Riley <emma.riley@ropetech.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, procurement@ropetech.com
Date: Tue, 28 Feb 2028 11:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RopeTech - initial redlines on MSA + Order Form

Laura / Karthik — procurement here. Quick answers to your questions:

- Productization scope: RopeTech prefers assignment to be scoped to the product lines named in the Order Form (list of three SKUs is in the current Order Form version). We do not want a company-wide blanket assignment.

- Retention window: default required window is 90 days for audit evidence. If you can do 90 days that will be sufficient for our security review.

- SOC2: we appreciate the SOC2 summary, but procurement will need a short doc that outlines what telemetry fields and logs Redwood will share (example: request id, timestamp, model version, prompt hash, sample output). If you can provide a short template runbook we can confirm tech acceptance.

Time: procurement still targets sign by 3/15; any blocking legal edits should be surfaced by 3/6. Happy to do a 30-min alignment call this week.

Thanks,
Matt
Procurement Lead, RopeTech

Laura / Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround. RopeTech confirms:
- Assignment limited to the three SKUs listed in the Order Form only.
- 90 day retention window is acceptable.
- For the runbook, procurement wants the fields Matt called out plus an example export and a named contact for engineering coordination.

We are available for a 30-min call tomorrow 3/1 at 10am PT if that helps. If you can share draft redlines before then, we can try to resolve on the call.

Emma

Great — thanks all. Summary & agreed MAP below (I'll own tracking):

MAP (target sign 3/15):
- 2/29 EOD: Redwood legal (Laura) to circulate redline suggestions (in progress).
- 3/1 10:00am PT: Alignment call to walk assignment language and runbook (proposed attendees: Laura, Ben, Karthik; RopeTech: Emma, Matt, engineering contact). Meeting invite to follow.
- 3/6: Final commercial redlines (if any) to be surfaced; procurement to confirm final terms.
- 3/8: Internal approvals and DocuSign package prep.
- 3/15: Target signature.

Compromise proposal (for the call): Redwood proposes the following carveout: a narrowly defined "Productized Outputs" assignment limited to Order Form SKUs + a 90-day evidence retention window. Training is prohibited unless RopeTech signs a separate training addendum; Redwood may collect sampled QA telemetry (anonymized) that is explicitly excluded from training except where RopeTech provides written consent.

I'll send a calendar invite for 3/1 10am PT and attach the current legal redline plus the SOC2 summary and runbook template.

Next: calendar invite + shared Drive folder (link in thread).
